args.summary: Latest deploy of checkout-api (v2.3.1) failed health checks in production. Rolled back all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Post-rollback verification confirms checkout-api is healthy on v2.3.0 across all regions with error rate ~0.2%. Recommend root-cause investigation of v2.3.1 before re-deploying.
args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Here's a summary of what was done:

## Actions Taken

1. **Investigated the failure** — Checked deployment history for `checkout-api`. The latest deploy, **v2.3.1** (production), was unhealthy. The most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.

2. **Rolled back all regions** — Deployed **v2.3.0** to all three production regions: `us-east`, `us-west`, and `eu-west`. Rollback was approved and completed successfully.

3. **Verified recovery** — Confirmed `checkout-api` is now running v2.3.0 in all regions, reporting healthy with an error rate of ~0.2%.

4. **Opened a SEV2 incident** — Created **INC-0001**: *"checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0"*, documenting the failed v2.3.1 deploy, the rollback to v2.3.0, and verification of recovery. On-call has been paged.

**Recommendation:** Root-cause the v2.3.1 failure before attempting a re-deploy.
